html:
Nha Trang to Saigon private car transfer offers visitors high-standard transportation from Vietnam’s best coastal city to Ho Chi Minh City. Besides easy and safe transfers with experienced drivers, this door-to-door shuttle service is also tailored to travellers’ requests, which ensures top convenience and flexibility.

NHA TRANG TO SAIGON PRIVATE CAR TRANSFER

Nha Trang To Saigon Distance

The distance from Nha Trang to Ho Chi Minh City is roughly 400 kilometres. It will take around 6 hours to pass by car. Trains, sleeper buses, airlines, and private cars are popular modes of transportation for visitors. Each one is suitable for a specific target traveller.

Those who prefer door-to-door shuttle services, flexibility, and the opportunity for sightseeing along the way should consider our private car transfer. Learn more about it as follows.

Travel From Nha Trang To Saigon By Car

If you want a Nha Trang to Ho Chi Minh City private car ride, first of all, you should give us the trip details (pickup time, locations, stops en route, etc.). Accordingly, we will inform you of all costs and confirm the trip if you agree to proceed with booking it.

Later, a driver and a private car will be sent to your requested hotel in Nha Trang to pick you up. Before kicking it off, our driver will help you carry the luggage and settle into the seats.

During the journey from Nha Trang to Saigon, please don’t hesitate to ask our driver to stop if you need a short break, use the toilet, or have lunch/dinner. Our experienced driver will find a suitable spot for you.

Upon arrival at your hotel in Ho Chi Minh City, our driver will drop you off, return your luggage, check the car seats in case you’ve forgotten anything, and then say goodbye. After all, your Nha Trang to Saigon private car trip finishes here.

Please contact Vietlook Travel immediately if you require any travel services. We wish you a wonderful time in Vietnam.

What Should You Visit Along The Way?

You will cross Khanh Hoa, Ninh Thuan, Binh Thuan, and Dong Nai before Saigon. If you’re fed up with a direct transfer from Nha Trang to Saigon, we can arrange a sightseeing trip with interesting tourist venues, such as:

Cam Ranh Bay (Khanh Hoa Province)

Apart from being a strategic spot, Cam Ranh Bay appeals to visitors as an untouched landscape. Unlike the modern appearance of Nha Trang beaches, the bay seems more rural, idyllic, and poetic.

You can drop by to admire the views and taste some signature seafood dishes made out of fresh squid, lobster, or crab.

Mui Ne (Binh Thuan Province)

If you’re interested in “beach heavens” in Vietnam, you must have heard of Mui Ne. It’s a national tourism area, boasting the best highlights, including dream-like beaches and impressive dunes.

If you’d like to take a look at Mui Ne Beach, our driver can make a brief stop at one of the most beautiful coastal viewpoints in the area.

Po Sah Inu Cham Towers

Known as the oldest temple in Binh Thuan, Po Sah Inu Towers will give visitors a sacred and mysterious atmosphere. It’s part of the Cham tower ruins collection, so it holds great significance in Vietnamese history and culture.

If you’re keen on ancient relics, historical constructions, and architecture, this site is worth your time.

Ho Chi Minh City

If you want to quickly see Saigon, we can do a no-guide city tour right away upon arrival. Our private car can take you around Ho Chi Minh City, show you to famous attractions, and introduce you to local eateries, before dropping you off at your hotel.

Notre Dame Cathedral, Independence Palace, and the Central Post Office are some must-see places. Besides, let’s try some street dishes, such as banh mi, com tam rice, pho Saigon, noodles, and coffee.
